rules.cite: SF.gov: Annual Rent Increase for 3/1/26 - 2/28/27 Announced
rules.coverage_text: Applies to rent-controlled units in San Francisco; the page does not define which buildings are covered.
rules.quote: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable rent increase effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6% of the tenant's base rent.
rules.title: SF annual allowable rent increase 2026-27
